subject: Workplace Skills
title: Adding Value Between Asks
description: Learn Adding Value Between Asks in one minute.

hook.text: She only called when she needed something. Eventually, people stopped picking up. She'd become a 'taker.'

buildup.text: Relationships die when they become one-directional. If your only outreach is requests, trust erodes fast.

discovery.text: For every ask, deposit five small acts of value: share an article, congratulate a win, or make an introduction.

twist.text: The value doesn't need to be large. A two-sentence congratulation on a promotion shows you're paying attention.

climax.text: Think of relationships as bank accounts. Make deposits regularly so withdrawals don't drain the balance.

punchline.text: Five deposits for every withdrawal. Feed the account.

quiz.question: What's the recommended ratio of giving to asking in relationships?
options: One-to-one: match every ask with one act of giving
Five-to-one: deposit five acts of value for every request
No specific ratio; just don't ask too often
